plain: To spread sickness to; to taint with disease or poison

webster.text: To taint with disease; to infuse into a healthy body the virus, miasma, or morbid matter of a diseased body, or any pestilential or noxious air or substance by which a disease is produced.

example.quote: How much more easily might so small a body as the Congress be infected !
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
